message_row.eventDescription: One Stocktwits message: text, Bullish/Bearish tag, cashtags, prices at posting, likes, replies and the author's followers and join date. A run that finds nothing is free.

symbol_row.eventDescription: One ticker's sentiment summary (watchers, daily bullish/bearish % history, tagged split and post rate of the latest messages) or one trending ticker (rank, trending score, why-it's-trending summary, fundamentals).
